# catalog-csv-download

catalog/service.cjs exports download(rows), where rows contains {sku,description} string pairs. Return CSV with header 'SKU,Description', a comma between cells and LF after every record, including the last. In each cell, if the value contains any comma, double quote, CR or LF, wrap the entire value in double quotes and double every embedded double quote. Otherwise emit it unchanged, including empty strings and spaces. Preserve embedded CR/LF, row order and input data. An empty array produces only the header record.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
